65	## How It Works
66	
67	CODEFLOW installs as a Claude Code hook that intercepts **all major tool calls** — Bash, Read, Grep, and Glob:
68	
69	```
70	Claude Code → PreToolUse hook → codeflow processes → compressed/deduped output
71	```
72	
73	**Layer 1 — Compression:** An 8-stage TOML filter pipeline strips noise from Bash command output:
74	- ANSI codes, download progress bars, empty lines
75	- Verbose compiler/test output condensed to errors + summary
76	- Long outputs truncated with head/tail
77	
78	**Layer 2 — Dedup:** Content-addressed cache detects repeated Bash command output within a session and returns a one-line summary instead of full content.
79	
80	**Layer 2.5 — Read Dedup:** Intercepts Read/Grep/Glob tool calls. If a file was recently read and hasn't changed (mtime verified), injects `additionalContext` telling Claude the file is unchanged — saving 30-50% of session tokens from re-reads.
81	
82	**Session Context:** Every tool call is logged per-session (SQLite WAL, <1ms writes). This powers dedup checks and waste detection.
83	
84	**Waste Detection:** Analyzes session tool logs to surface waste patterns — files read 8x, identical greps, failed searches, glob spam.
85	
86	**Tracking:** Every compression and dedup event is logged locally (SQLite, 90-day retention) so you can see exactly how many tokens you're saving.
87	
88	## Filters
89	
90	15 built-in TOML filters for common commands:
91	
92	| Command | What it strips |
93	|---------|---------------|
94	| `git diff` | Index lines, no-newline markers, truncates long lines |
95	| `git status` | Hint text, compact modified/added/deleted prefixes |
96	| `git log` | Empty lines, truncates to 200 lines |
97	| `cargo build/test` | Compiling/Downloading lines, timing normalization |
98	| `npm test` | Warnings, stack traces, PASS/FAIL symbols |
99	| `pytest` | Warnings summary, site-packages paths |
100	| `tsc` | Empty lines, truncated long error lines |
101	| `eslint` | Empty lines, problem count summaries |
102	| `docker logs` | Timestamps stripped, head/tail |
103	| `go test` | PASS/FAIL symbols, timing normalization |
104	| `pip install` | Download/cache lines, collecting lines |
105	| `find` | Permission denied errors, head/tail |
106	| `grep` | Binary match lines, truncated long lines |
107	| `ls` | Total line, head/tail for large directories |
108	
109	### Custom Filters
110	
111	Create TOML files in `~/.local/share/codeflow/filters/`:
112	
113	```toml
114	strip_ansi = true
115	on_empty = "(no output)"
116	
117	[command]
118	name = "mycommand"
119	args_contain = ["--verbose"]
120	
121	[[strip_lines]]
122	pattern = '^DEBUG:'
123	
124	[head_tail]
125	head = 20
126	tail = 10
127	separator = "\n... ({omitted} lines omitted) ...\n"
128	
129	max_lines = 100
130	```
131	
132	## Commands
133	
134	```
135	codeflow init [-g]              Install hooks (project or global)
136	codeflow uninit [-g]            Remove hooks
137	codeflow wrap <cmd> [args]      Manually compress a command
138	codeflow stats [--json]         Show savings dashboard
139	codeflow stats --waste [--json] Show waste pattern analysis
140	codeflow cache clear            Clear dedup cache
141	codeflow cache info             Show cache statistics
142	codeflow sync [--once]          Sync events to cloud (Phase 2)
143	codeflow update                 Show version and update info
144	```
145	
146	## Fail-Open Design
147	
148	Any internal error → original output passed unchanged. CODEFLOW never breaks your workflow:
149	- Invalid hook input → passthrough + stderr warning
150	- Filter crash → original output returned
151	- Database error → output still works, event not logged
152	
153	## Architecture
154	
155	```
156	cli/                    Rust workspace
157	├── crates/core/        Compression, dedup, events, tracking
158	├── crates/cli/         Binary, hooks, stats, sync
159	├── filters/            TOML filter definitions
160	└── proto/              Protobuf event schema
161	
162	cloud/                  Go ingest server (Phase 2)
163	├── cmd/ingest/         HTTP server
164	└── internal/           ClickHouse client, API handlers
165	
166	dashboard/              Next.js + React (Phase 2)
167	└── src/                Overview, settings pages
168	```

177	cd cli && cargo test
178	
179	# Run locally

181	```

- Single `events.proto` (Protobuf v3)
- Defines: `EventBatch`, `Event`, `CompressionEvent`, `DedupEvent`
- Compiled at build time to `cli/crates/core/src/proto_generated.rs` and `cloud/proto/events.pb.go`
- Used for CLI→Cloud event serialization

**Database:**

- **ClickHouse 24.8** (4 main tables + 3 materialized views)
- TTL policy: 90-day retention
- Partitioned by month for fast range queries
- SummingMergeTree views for pre-aggregated analytics

- **Rust:** Cargo workspace with shared version/license in Cargo.toml
- **Go:** go.mod with explicit v1.25 requirement, 13 direct deps
